en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad and Abdullah, two sons of Muhammad Bin Isa, from their father, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Ismail Bin Abu Ziyad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup> professed to Al-Islam by the accounting of Al-Jummal (Use of alphabetical letters in accordance to their numerical value)’, and he<sup>asws</sup> formed ‘sixty three’ with his<sup>asws</sup> hands’.
